title: NASA-UAP-D027, Apollo 14 Debriefing (Continued), 1971
what_is_it: A NASA audio recording (with metadata catalogue entry) of the second segment of the Apollo 14 post-mission crew debriefing.
interpretation_warnings: No document body text was extractable (scanned/OCR-poor or audio-only); all facts are drawn from war.gov catalogue metadata, not from the source content itself.

The 'light flash phenomena' described is a well-documented biological effect of cosmic rays on the retina, not evidence of an unidentified aerial phenomenon, despite the document's inclusion in a UAP collection.
Individual crew members and debriefers are not identified in the available metadata.
